terms:
Government taxes and charges extra as applicable.
Bills are settled by cash or card at the end of the party.
30% advance, and 70% on the day of the party.
Bar service runs for 2.5 hours only.
Pass-around starters are served for 2 hours only.
The confirmed minimum number of guests is the minimum billed on the day.
We may refuse service to intoxicated guests.
Outside alcohol is not allowed.
The management is not responsible for loss, damage or theft of guests' belongings.
Food and drinks ordered outside the package are charged extra.
Audio and video are controlled by NASHA; song requests are at the management's discretion.
Drinks are subject to availability.
Menu choices must be made at least 24 hours in advance.
Cocktails are made only with the liquor in the chosen package.
Please order responsibly and avoid wastage.
Our standard measure is 30 ml.
Party food cannot be packed to take away.
Red Bull, ginger ale and tonic water are charged extra.
